about: What each same-rows rewrite keeps the same, and on which conditions (night 14). Five aspects are checked for every rewrite: matching (which rows find a partner), NULLs (what a row with nothing to match or total gets), duplicates (how often each row comes out), ordering (what decides the order and the page boundary) and grain (what one result row is). proof = 'query' when the query's text alone proves it; 'schema' when it holds only if the listed table facts are true. Every contract was checked on MariaDB 10.11 and PostgreSQL 16 by tests/practice/test_night14.py and the stmtbugs generator.

matching.en: the LEFT JOIN uses the same equality as the subquery's link, so each outer row meets exactly the child rows it counted before; a NULL link matches nothing either way
matching.hi: LEFT JOIN wahi barabari use karta hai jo subquery ka link tha; NULL link dono mein kuch match nahi karta

nulls.en: a parent with no child rows: COUNT is 0 in the subquery and NULL after the LEFT JOIN, so COUNT is wrapped in COALESCE(..., 0); SUM, MIN, MAX and AVG are NULL both ways and stay unwrapped
nulls.hi: bina child wala parent: subquery mein COUNT 0, LEFT JOIN ke baad NULL, isliye COALESCE(..., 0); SUM/MIN/MAX/AVG dono mein NULL

duplicates.en: the derived table is grouped by the link column, so it has one row per link value and the LEFT JOIN never repeats an outer row
duplicates.hi: derived table link column se grouped hai, har value ki ek row, isliye LEFT JOIN koi row dohrata nahi

ordering.en: the ORDER BY is kept, with each copy of the subquery replaced by the same value
ordering.hi: ORDER BY wahi, har copy ki jagah wahi value

grain.en: one row per outer row, as before
grain.hi: pehle jaisi, har bahar ki row ek baar

matching.en: the subquery is the same text, run for the same outer rows
matching.hi: wahi subquery, wahi bahar ki rows

nulls.en: the value is computed once and used by name, so a NULL stays NULL in every place
nulls.hi: value ek baar nikalti hai, NULL har jagah NULL

duplicates.en: wrapping a query in a derived table neither adds nor removes rows
duplicates.hi: derived table mein rakhne se rows na badhti na ghatti

ordering.en: ORDER BY by the name sorts by the very same value
ordering.hi: ORDER BY naam se wahi value se sort

matching.en: an uncorrelated total gives one value for the whole query; each place now reads that value
matching.hi: bina correlation ka total poori query ke liye ek value; har jagah wahi

nulls.en: a total over no rows is NULL (COUNT 0) in both forms
nulls.hi: khaali rows ka total dono mein NULL (COUNT 0)

duplicates.en: a total without GROUP BY always has exactly one row, so CROSS JOIN with it adds and loses no row
duplicates.hi: bina GROUP BY ka total hamesha ek row, CROSS JOIN se koi row na badhti na ghatti

matching.en: x IN (SELECT y ...) and EXISTS (... AND y = x) both keep a row when some inner row has y = x
matching.hi: dono tab row rakhte hain jab andar koi row y = x ho

nulls.en: a NULL x or y matches in neither; IN may be NULL where EXISTS is false, which only NOT tells apart, so it is offered only where nothing negates it
nulls.hi: NULL dono mein match nahi; IN NULL ho sakta hai jahan EXISTS false, farak sirf NOT se, isliye NOT na ho tabhi

duplicates.en: neither form repeats an outer row, whatever the inner table holds
duplicates.hi: koi bhi form row nahi dohrata

grain.en: one row per outer row, as before

matching.en: EXISTS with one link inner.y = outer.x and the other conditions on the inner table keeps exactly the rows whose x is among those y values
matching.hi: ek link aur baaki conditions andar ki table pe: wahi rows jinka x un y mein hai

nulls.en: a NULL matches in neither; NOT EXISTS and NOT IN are not the same when a column can be NULL, so only the positive form is rewritten
nulls.hi: NULL dono mein match nahi; NOT IN aur NOT EXISTS NULL pe alag, isliye sirf positive form

duplicates.en: neither form repeats an outer row

matching.en: the JOIN's ON is the IN's equality, with the subquery's own conditions inside the derived table
matching.hi: JOIN ka ON wahi barabari, subquery ki conditions derived table ke andar

duplicates.en: the derived table is SELECT DISTINCT of the column, one row per value, so an outer row comes out at most once, as with IN (a plain JOIN would repeat it once per match)
duplicates.hi: SELECT DISTINCT: har value ki ek row, isliye bahar ki row zyada se zyada ek baar (seedha JOIN dohrata)

grain.en: one row per outer row that has a match
grain.hi: har match wali bahar ki row ek baar

nulls.en: the name holds the very value of the calculation, NULL included
nulls.hi: naam mein calculation ki wahi value, NULL bhi

duplicates.en: no row is added or removed
duplicates.hi: koi row na badhti na ghatti

ordering.en: ORDER BY the SELECT name sorts by the same value on MariaDB and PostgreSQL; offered only when no table column has that name
ordering.hi: ORDER BY naam wahi value se sort karta hai; sirf tab jab kisi column ka wo naam na ho

matching.en: a condition on a GROUP BY column is true for every row of a group or for none, so filtering rows before grouping keeps exactly the groups HAVING kept
matching.hi: GROUP BY column ki condition group ki har row pe ek jaisi, isliye pehle filter karne se wahi groups

nulls.en: a NULL key fails the condition in both places

duplicates.en: each group still comes out once

grain.en: one row per group, as before

matching.en: a constant column that differs in each part proves no row of one part can equal a row of another
matching.hi: har hisse ka alag constant column sabit karta hai ki do hisson ki row same nahi ho sakti

nulls.en: UNION treats two NULLs as equal; UNION ALL keeps both, so a part's own NULL repeats matter too
nulls.hi: UNION do NULL ko barabar maanta hai; UNION ALL dono rakhta hai

duplicates.en: UNION also removes repeats inside one part, so UNION ALL is the same only when each part has no repeated rows of its own
duplicates.hi: UNION ek hisse ke andar ke repeat bhi hatata hai, isliye UNION ALL tabhi same jab har hisse mein apne repeat na hon

ordering.en: only the final ORDER BY decides the order, in both
ordering.hi: order sirf aakhri ORDER BY tay karta hai

grain.en: one row per distinct row of each part
grain.hi: har hisse ki har alag row

holds_if.en: each part returns no repeated rows of its own (it lists a key, or has DISTINCT / GROUP BY on all its columns)
holds_if.hi: har hisse mein apne repeat rows na hon (key ho, ya saare columns pe DISTINCT / GROUP BY)

matching.en: the WHERE keeps the rows that come after the last row seen in the ORDER BY's own order
matching.hi: WHERE wahi rows rakhta hai jo ORDER BY ke order mein aakhri dekhi row ke baad aati hain

nulls.en: a sort column that can be NULL breaks 'after the last row' (a comparison with NULL is never true), so the sort columns must be NOT NULL
nulls.hi: sort column NULL ho to 'baad wali row' toot jaata hai, isliye sort columns NOT NULL hone chahiye

duplicates.en: the ORDER BY ends in a unique column, so no row sits on two pages and none is skipped
duplicates.hi: ORDER BY unique column pe khatam, isliye koi row do page pe nahi aati, koi chhoot-ti nahi

ordering.en: the same ORDER BY, every column in the same direction
ordering.hi: wahi ORDER BY, har column ek hi direction mein

holds_if.en: the last ORDER BY column is unique (a key) and the sort columns are NOT NULL
holds_if.hi: aakhri ORDER BY column unique (key) ho aur sort columns NOT NULL hon

holds_if.en: the application passes the last row of the page before (page N needs page N-1; it cannot jump to page 500 directly)
holds_if.hi: app pichhle page ki aakhri row bheje (seedha page 500 pe nahi ja sakte)

matching.en: the condition moved off the column onto the values: for every value of the column the same rows pass
matching.hi: condition column se hata ke values pe: har value ke liye wahi rows

duplicates.en: no row is added or removed
duplicates.hi: koi row na badhti na ghatti

matching.en: each UNION ALL branch keeps one side of the OR
matching.hi: har UNION ALL hissa OR ki ek taraf

nulls.en: the later branch leaves out rows the earlier one returned with a test that is also true for NULL (... IS NOT TRUE)
nulls.hi: baad wala hissa pehle wale ki rows chhodta hai, NULL ko bhi sambhal ke

duplicates.en: no row is returned by two branches, and none is lost
duplicates.hi: koi row do hisson se nahi aati, koi chhoot-ti nahi

ordering.en: only an ORDER BY over the whole UNION decides the order
ordering.hi: order poore UNION pe ORDER BY se
